title: Instruction-placement team config
description: Schema for instruction-placement.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the declined findings that /instruction-placement:audit, delta and realign read and realign writes, listed in plugins/instruction-placement/reference/consumer-config.md. Entry format: the finding-suppression contract.

suppressions.description: Declined findings keyed by finding_id, the hash of each entry's check, claim and sites.

date.description: The day the decline was recorded, as YYYY-MM-DD.
